### 2.1 Delta 1 — the field-layer closure: CONFIRMED, and its unverified premise is now verified

- RS6 = X⁶−100X⁴+6000X²+32000X+40000: irreducible over ℚ **and over ℚ(√5)** (sympy, extension factorization); exactly 2 real roots; Galois group of order 60 on 6 points.
- **The premise the record asserted but did not check — that RS6's splitting field is the quintic's** — I verified by a Frobenius-correlation test: across all 428 unramified primes < 3000, the quintic's cycle type and RS6's factorization pattern match the PSL(2,5)-on-6-points dictionary ((5)↔(1,5); (1,1,3)↔(3,3); (1,2,2)↔(1,1,2,2)) with **zero mismatches**; disc(RS6) = 2⁴⁸5²⁰. Two independent A₅-extensions would decorrelate immediately; this pins closure(RS6) = closure(quintic) beyond reasonable doubt. The Lemma's group step is sound (A₅ element orders {1,2,3,5}; order-15 subgroups are cyclic, order-30 forces index 2 against simplicity; hence A₅×C₂ has no index-4 subgroup), the Kummer step checks by hand (√5·φ = (5+√5)/2, √(√5φ) = 2sin(2π/5), minpoly x⁴−5x²+5 = ℚ(ζ₂₀)⁺), and therefore **i ∉ K12(ζ₅) stands as a theorem.** This is, in my judgment, the sharpest single narrowing Open #8 has received: the fork now lives entirely at the analytic deck, by proof rather than census.
- The crossing table (gap² class-determined; √(φ+2) = 2sin(2π/5)) is elementary and exact as stated.
- Scope note for countersign: the theorem is about K12(ζ₅); the claim "the tower's field layer" ⊆ K12(ζ₅) is a specification statement inherited from the rung-1 census, not part of the proof. One sentence in the record acknowledging that boundary would make the [T] airtight.

### 2.6 Findings (the defect list)

- **F1 — the "Serre lacunarity" citation is misattributed, and it propagated.** Rung 2, the rung-3 opening (§2.2), and the third review's §2 all state the icosahedral boundary as "*by Serre's lacunarity theorem*, weight-1 eta-quotient/lacunary constructions are exactly the CM forms — the icosahedral form has no eta expression, **provably**." Fresh check: Serre's lacunarity theorem (Glasgow Math. J. 1985 lineage) characterizes lacunary forms of weight **> 1** as CM combinations; in weight 1 the statement "lacunary ⟹ CM" is **false** — *every* weight-1 eigenform is lacunary (finite image forces a positive density of a_p = 0; the icosahedral form itself has density-¼ zeros). The strategic conclusion (no eta-quotient expression for the icosahedral form; rung 2's engine cannot climb) is almost certainly still true, but its support is the eta-quotient classification literature (Mersmann's finiteness/classification of holomorphic eta quotients; Y. Martin's list of multiplicative eta-quotients; Dummit–Kisilevsky–McKay for two-factor products), not Serre lacunarity. **Action:** re-cite in rung 2 and the rung-3 opening; downgrade "provably" to the classification-scoped statement until an exact citation is in hand; the third review inherits a one-line erratum by its own convention. This is the only substantive mathematical defect this review found, and it is a citation defect, not a result defect — but it currently props a [T] tag on a load-bearing boundary.
- **F2 — Delta 6's moment instrument lacks its sample lines** (closed from outside in §2.4; add source + prime-range per form, and a note that the pre-registered JSON omits the a_p = 0 primes).
- **F3 — Delta 4 gauge-datum subscript** (𝔭₂ vs 𝔭₃; the prime is 3).
- **F4 — Carrier rung-3 Deltas 2 and 3 are missing from the archive entirely.** They are cited as load-bearing by Delta 4 ("Delta 3 §F"; "the Delta-3 expansion"; the readability-protocol appendix) and Delta 5 ("proven at two depths (Deltas 2–3)"; the frozen μ₈ chirality key), and they exist nowhere in Drive (title and full-text searched; only Delta 4 has a stray Docs-native copy in another location) nor in the repo (which ends at rung 2). The cited *computational content* is independently reconstructed by this review (the two θ-identities prove the two-depth boundary-null claims; the η(8τ)η(16τ) expansion and the 16-prime chirality key recompute), so the chain's mathematics is not at risk — but the records themselves, including Delta 3's abelian machine model (§F) and whatever Delta 2 contains, are unrecoverable unless the session container or log survives. **Action: recover and upload before the container is lost; if unrecoverable, file a gap record stating what Deltas 2–3 contained, sourced from Delta 4/5's citations and this review's reconstructions.** For a corpus whose signature discipline is the complete dated record, this is the hygiene item that matters most.

## 3. What rung 3 actually did to Open #8 — structural read

Assembling the verified chain: **the fork narrowed twice and advanced one floor.** Delta 1 closed the algebraic half by theorem (the i-layer is not a function of tower field data, because A₅ is simple — "solvability = communicability" as literal Galois theory, now with every premise verified). Delta 4 then showed the one remaining door — the analytic deck — *does* carry per-object i-data at the dihedral floor, by a mechanism (finite answer-free census + contraction flow + chirality read) that is classical in substance but correctly abstracted as the **locator** family, whose axioms are the right transfer object for the climb. The honest summary sentence for the ledger is the record's own: the structural-no is dead *at this floor*; the icosahedral question is now precisely whether an answer-free terminal census exists at the boundary of weight space. That is rung 4's eigencurve spec, and my anchor checks (BD étale at exotic points; Hida-family accessibility from weight-2 ordinary data; a₂ = 0 forcing the odd-prime stations) confirm it is well-posed as pre-registered in Delta 5 §5. What rung 3 did **not** do — and says it did not do — is move the imported-vs-exhibited needle above the dihedral floor, or touch forced-vs-chosen in the physics register. Delta 5's scoped guide-verdict ("guide at the level of where-to-look, dictionary at the level of what-is-true") is scored on outcomes, includes its own kill (H4), and is the right size; I recommend countersigning it *with its boundary sentence quoted whole*, since it is exactly the sentence citation drift would erode first.

On the Deltas 6–9 register (the skeleton-native pass): the budget calculus is real as a calculus — the port theorem is Satake/Weyl in budget dress and the record says so; the gauges organize the campaign's empirical structure genuinely well (the two-conflation-lost-bits observation is the best compression of the whole campaign I have seen). The mint condition ("a budget-native identity the classical side has not named") is now well-posed with three named candidates (ε-phase/Ptolemy composition; γ*-wiring/self-transmission; Sym²-toll calibration) — none computed. Until one pays out, the two-ledger discipline holds the register at "true chart, exact laws, working instruments; *the* skeleton still = the forced-vs-chosen floor." The records themselves say this; countersign should freeze it.
